business_summary: Qingdao Richen Food Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of compound seasoning in China. The company offers sauces and seasonings, including marinade sauces, spread sauces, noodle sauces, stir-fry sauces, cooking liquids, cold dish sauces, salad dressings, flavored soups, grilled fish seasonings, and hot pot seasonings; and Chinese stir-fry, roasting, ramen soup, crayfish, and light meal seasonings. It also provides powdered seasonings, such as coating, marinade, compound soup, and premixed powders; products for barbecue, deep-fried, and soups; frozen dough products; and food additive products comprising compound acidity regulators, compound moisture retainers, caramel coloring, etc. for use as additives in various processed foods. The company serves chain restaurants, food processing companies, and brand retailers. Qingdao Richen Food Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is based in Qingdao, China. Qingdao Richen Food Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Qingdao Boya Investment Holding Co., Ltd.
